_comment: FROZEN 2026-09-25. Calibrated on world_seed=99 only, never used in the experiment. Budget and controller timing are set so growth happens DURING learning rather than after convergence: pilots showed D0-D2 saturate by ~3000 steps while D3 decays from 0.74 to chance as the model shifts from a rule-like to a memorised solution. Running to convergence would compare six converged models with no signal left to separate them. See RESEARCH_LOG.md.
